description: Header file defining the QuicheDataWriter class for packing binary data, including methods for writing integers, strings, tags, and variable-length integers, as well as related enums and constants.

classes.name: QuicheDataWriter
classes.description: A class for packing binary data with methods to write various primitive types, strings, tags, and variable-length integers into a buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteBytesToUInt64
methods.description: Writes the least significant |num_bytes| of a 64-bit unsigned integer in correct byte order.

methods.name: WriteStringPiece
methods.description: Writes a string piece to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteStringPiece16
methods.description: Writes a string piece with a 16-bit length prefix.

methods.name: WriteBytes
methods.description: Writes raw bytes to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteRepeatedByte
methods.description: Fills the buffer with a repeated byte.

methods.name: WritePadding
methods.description: Fills remaining buffer with null characters.

methods.name: WritePaddingBytes
methods.description: Writes padding of specified byte count.

methods.name: WriteTag
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit tag in big endian order.

methods.name: WriteVarInt62
methods.description: Encodes a 62-bit unsigned integer using RFC 9000 variable length encoding.

methods.name: WriteVarInt62WithForcedLength
methods.description: Encodes a 62-bit unsigned integer with a forced length.

methods.name: WriteStringPieceVarInt62
methods.description: Writes a string as a length/content pair with length encoded as VarInt62.

methods.name: GetVarInt62Len
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes needed to encode a value using VarInt62.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified length without writing data.
